query.name: genre_underperformance
query.sql:
SELECT g.genre AS genre,
       avg(CASE WHEN m.year = 1999 THEN m.rank END) AS rating_current,
       avg(CASE WHEN m.year = 1998 THEN m.rank END) AS rating_prior,
       count(CASE WHEN m.year = 1999 THEN 1 END) AS titles_current,
       count(CASE WHEN m.year = 1998 THEN 1 END) AS titles_prior
FROM imdb.genres AS g
INNER JOIN imdb.movies AS m ON m.id = g.movie_id
WHERE m.year IN (1999, 1998) AND m.rank > 0
GROUP BY g.genre
HAVING count(CASE WHEN m.year = 1999 THEN 1 END) >= 20
   AND count(CASE WHEN m.year = 1998 THEN 1 END) >= 20
ORDER BY rating_current - rating_prior ASC
